extracted.name: Oatmeal Energy Balls
extracted.description: For this recipe, rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, and raisins are rolled into little oatmeal energy balls that are perfect for on-the-go snacking.
instruction_lines: Combine oats, peanut butter, raisins, and honey in a bowl with a fork; knead by hand until fully incorporated. Roll into 1-inch balls. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
